svg.title: Intrusive volcanic features
svg.desc: Magma that cools underground forms a batholith with a metamorphic aureole around it, a laccolith, a dyke and a sill; later uplift and erosion remove the rock above and expose the granite batholith, as in the Leinster Batholith.

g.text: magma forces its way in and cools slowly underground
the rock on top is worn away
